[Recruiter - Divanshi Gupta (17 Nov 2026, 15:06)]: Hi,As per our discussion on the call, I have shared a job description for the International Ecommerce Manager position. Kindly review it and send your updated resume.Company Name- Olympia Industries Ltd Location- Goregaon east , MumbaiProfile- International Ecommerce ManagerExperience – 4 + years ctc- upto 12 LpaWorking Days – 6 days  (2nd and 4th sat off)Website- www.eolympia.comWe are seeking a dynamic and results-driven International E-Commerce Manager to lead and scale our global online sales across key international markets. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, optimizing cross-border logistics, and tailoring strategies for region-specific performance on platforms such as Alibaba, Amazon Global, Shopify, Etsy, and eBay.Key Skills & QualificationsMin 4 Years experience in international e-commerce sales. Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Marketing, International Business, or a related fieldStrong understanding of cross-border B2B/B2C platforms (Alibaba, Amazon Global, Shopify)Proficient in digital marketing strategies for international markets.Excellent communication, leadership, and analytical skills.Familiarity with ERP systems, e-commerce analytics tools, and marketplace dashboardsJob description1. International E-Commerce Strategy & GrowthDevelop and execute global e-commerce strategies across USA, Europe, Middle East, and Asia.Increase YoY international revenue by identifying high-potential markets and customer segments.Launch and manage regional storefronts on global platforms like Alibaba.com, Amazon Global, Etsy, eBay, and Shopify Plus.2. Platform Optimization & Sales EnablementOptimize product listings, UX, pricing, and promotional strategies to increase traffic, conversions, and AOV.Leverage data analytics to improve performance metrics and inform business decisions.3. Market LocalizationAdapt marketing strategies and product offerings based on regional preferences, cultural nuances, seasonal trends, and compliance requirements.Collaborate with design and sourcing teams to ensure regional alignment in fabric, design, and pricing.4. Digital Marketing & Customer AcquisitionImplement paid media campaigns, influencer marketing, and multilingual content strategies to increase global reach and conversion rates.Monitor ROI across digital channels and optimize campaigns for performance.5. Logistics & Supply Chain ManagementManage cross-border logistics operations and partnerships with third- party logistics (3PL) providers.Reduce international delivery time and enhance the customer experience through proactive supply chain solutions.6. Compliance & Risk ManagementEnsure compliance with import/export laws, labeling standards, and regional e-commerce regulations.Stay updated on international trade requirements, tariffs, and certifications.7. Team Management & CollaborationLead and mentor a multicultural e-commerce and customer support team.Align internal stakeholders across marketing, sales, logistics, and finance for seamless execution of global initiatives.Fill in your details . (Mandatory)Name:-Contact no:-Email Id:-Qualification:-Current location:-Current organization name:-Industry:-Experience:-CTC:-Expected CTC:-Offer in Hand:-Notice Period :-Negotiable Notice Period :-Willing to Relocate:-Are you available for the final round F2F?Kindly attach a passport-sized photograph and your updated resume-- Thanks & Regards,Divanshi GuptaRecruitment Executive +91-9289321002Divanshi@orbitouch-hr.com

[Recruiter - Divanshi Gupta (16 Nov 2026, 15:30)]: Hi,As per our discussion on the call, I have shared a job description for the
Project Manager  position. Kindly review it and send your updated resume.Company Name- RMES India Private LimitedLocation- HyderabadProfile- Project ManagerExperience- 8 – 12 YearsBudget- upto 20-22 lpa (depends on interview)Working days- 5 daysWebsite- www.ruggedmonitoring.comBuilt for AI-native builders: We are an AI-native company where disruptive thinking is part of our DNA and expected in every role. This role is ideal for ambitious people who enjoy working with AI tools and bots and want to deliver at scale through AI-native execution. If that excites you, we would love to hear from you.ROLE OVERVIEWWe are seeking an experienced and seasoned Project Manager to lead end-to-end project delivery in Hyderabad, India. The Project Manager is the primary interface between the client and our internal execution team — taking extreme ownership of every assigned project, managing client negotiations, and ensuring all aspects of delivery (cost, schedule, quality, logistics, and commercial terms) are executed with precision, urgency, and professionalism. The role is measured on schedule adherence, quality, responsiveness, cash, revenue, and margin.KEY PERFORMANCE FOCUSThe Project Manager is accountable for delivering results across the following business outcomes:Schedule – Meet committed milestones, FAT dates, and shipment dates through proactive planning and recovery.Quality – Right-first-time design packages, documentation, and execution, with disciplined technical review.Responsiveness – Fast, clear, and timely response to customers, internal teams, and escalations.Cash – Timely milestone billing, invoicing, and collections tied to project progress.Revenue – Accurate forecasting and on-time revenue recognition from project deliveries.Margin – Protect and improve project profitability through cost control, change-order management, and cost/margin reviews.CORE RESPONSIBILITIESProject Engineering OversightOversee, guide, and track the day-to-day work of Project Engineers across assigned projects.Review and approve technical outputs from the PE team: designs, proposals, FAT procedures, BOMs, and cost reports.Identify bottlenecks in engineering delivery and take corrective action to keep projects on track.Ensure technical quality and completeness of all deliverables before submission to clients.Ensure the standard design package, templates, and system architecture are followed and reviewed with sound technical logic — avoiding unreviewed copy-paste designs and repeated review cyclesCommunicate technical requirements and project information clearly and promptly to Design, Engineering, and ProductionClient Negotiations & Commercial ManagementLead negotiations with clients on project scope, timelines, cost variations, and contract terms.Manage change orders: evaluate the cost and schedule impact of scope changes and negotiate equitable settlements.Prepare and present cost & margin reports; [Recruiter - Divanshi Gupta (6 Nov 2026, 12:51)]: Hi,As per our discussion on the call, I have shared a job description for the Senior Product Designer position. Kindly review it and send your updated resume.Company Name- RMES India Private LimitedLocation- HyderabadProfile- Senior Product DesignerExperience- 5-8 YearsCtc- 22-30 LPA (Depends on interview) Working days- 5 days (9:30am- 5:30 pm)Website- www.ruggedmonitoring.comWhat you will own • Define end-to-end journeys, workflows, information architecture, navigation, interaction models,and interface behavior across our digital product portfolio.• Turn complex industrial monitoring, configuration, analytics, and alerting requirements intoexperiences that feel clear, fast, trustworthy, and polished.• Lead focused customer discovery, prototype rapidly, test critical assumptions, and use evidenceto shape product requirements before implementation becomes expensive.• Set and evolve the visual and interaction direction of our software - typography, hierarchy,layout, color, motion, data visualization, responsiveness, and states.• Build a practical design system that accelerates delivery and creates consistency withoutbecoming a process-heavy project of its own.• Partner directly with Product and Engineering from early exploration through shipped quality,resolving gaps between design intent and production behavior.AI-native is a core expectationWe expect you to use modern AI capabilities as part of your normal design andproduct-building workflow. The goal is not to produce more artifacts. The goal is toreach better decisions and ship excellent product experiences materially faster.• Use AI for research synthesis, exploration, UX writing, prototyping, design-system work,documentation, critique, implementation support, and repetitive production tasks.• Create functional prototypes and lightweight front-end implementations when they help validatean idea, expose edge cases, or communicate behavior better than static screens.• Explore multiple credible directions quickly, then apply independent judgment to select, refine,and defend the strongest solution.• Build reusable prompts, workflows, scripts, components, or small internal tools that compoundthe team's speed over time.• Treat generated output as raw material: verify accuracy, accessibility, security, usability, andrelevance before it reaches customers.• Continuously evaluate new tools and adopt them when they create meaningful leverage - notbecause they are fashionable.What we are looking for• 5-8 years of strong product-design experience, with evidence of owning substantial productareas from discovery through launch and iteration.• A portfolio showing excellent product thinking, information architecture, interaction design,visual craft, and shipped outcomes - not only polished screens.• Demonstrated ability to simplify complex workflows and data-heavy interfaces without losingessential context or control.• Strong command of Figma, component-based design, responsive behavior, accessibility,interaction states, and design systems.• Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to compress research, exploration, prototyping,documentation, or implementation cycles.• Enough technical fluency to collaborate deeply with engineers; working knowledge of HTML andCSS is expected, while JavaScript or modern front-end frameworks is a strong advantage.• Excellent written and verbal communication, clear design rationale, and comfort makingdecisions under ambiguity and time pressure.• Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, industrial applications, IoT, monitoringplatforms, analytics, dashboards, or other operational products is valuable.
Fill in your details .
